title: fix(lint)!: an object-grid column summary the aggregate door refuses is refused at authoring, under list-view-summary-field-type-refused
body:
Fixes #32503

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no column summary on an `object-grid` component (the `summary` examples in `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` sit on list-view columns, all accepted pairs); the reasoning ships in the `os explain list-view-summary-field-type-refused` entry, which now names the grid carrier.

domain:spec#2 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcSbLCxEmyHf9upz3pz (dev branch `claude/issue-32503-object-grid-column-summary`)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:页面表格块(`object-grid`)的列配置 `properties.columns[].summary`(列底汇总),凡是服务端聚合入口会拒绝的「函数 × 字段类型」组合(如文本列求和),保存页面/校验时直接报错,规则沿用列表视图已有的 `list-view-summary-field-type-refused`,判据、文案、修复提示与列表视图完全同一份。
- **为什么改**:表格块的列和列表视图的列是同一个结构,分页表格的列底会发同一条全量聚合查询,被服务端以 400 拒绝后列底退回本页数字;此前列表视图和表格块的分组汇总都已在保存时拦截,唯独这第三个入口没人判。
- **风险与回滚**:只拦聚合×字段类型表本就拒绝的组合,布尔求和、日期最小/最大照常放行。第一方:examples 4 个应用共 30 个页面、2 个表格块、0 个列汇总,packages/apps 无表格块,命中 0。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` 的 `columnSummaryRefusal`(从原 `checkColumnSummary` 原样抽出的共用判据);`packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts` 的 `validateGridAggregations`(新增的列遍历段)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-sortable-fields.test.ts`,预期全绿;其中「gives the verdict, the words and the fix a list view's column gives」逐一核对每个汇总成员 × 每个字段类型 × 是否多值,两个入口结论与文案一致。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

An `object-grid` page component's `properties.columns` is the list view's own column union (`ObjectGridPropsSchema.columns` is `ListViewSchema.shape.columns`, `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`), so a `ListColumn` `summary` is accepted there. A paged, ungrouped grid that owns its fetch asks the footer's whole-set aggregate query of those summaries, and the engine's `aggregate` door answers a refused pair with `400 INVALID_FIELD`. List-view summaries and grid `aggregations` were judged at authoring; this third carrier was judged by no lint member.

1. **One verdict, extracted, not copied.** `checkColumnSummary`'s body in `validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` moves verbatim into an exported `columnSummaryRefusal(column, graph, object)`, which returns the refusal's `message` and `hint` (or nothing). The list-view closure now calls it. The pair is still judged by `aggregateAcceptsDeclaration` from `aggregate-pair-verdict.ts` (import only, no second type list), so `sum` over a boolean and `min` / `max` over a date stay accepted.
2. **The grid walk judges the columns.** `validateGridAggregations` in `validate-sortable-fields.ts` (the member that declares `page`, so the refusal lands at the page save door) now walks `properties.columns[]` too. It uses the same block binding (`dataSource.object`, else `properties.objectName`) and the same served graph as the aggregations, and reports at `pages[i]…properties.columns[j].summary`, `error`.
3. **Rule id: the existing `list-view-summary-field-type-refused`, extended.** The carrier is the list view's own `ListColumn` entry with its `ColumnSummary` member vocabulary (`count_unique`), and the fix line spells members, so the list-view id and its words fit; the grid id's words are about group-header aggregations. The two ids stay on one block side by side (pinned).
4. **`os explain list-view-summary-field-type-refused`** gains one paragraph naming the grid carrier, its binding, the save-time refusal, and that a grouped grid's header numbers come from `aggregations`, not from column summaries.
5. **ADR-0087 D3 upgrade-guide entry `object-grid-column-summary-refused`** (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-grid-column-summary-refused.ts`, rework round 1). A narrowed changeset may no longer declare `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` (seat decision on #32601, PR #32649), so the changeset marker is now `adr-0087: registered object-grid-column-summary-refused`. The entry states the surface (`ui.ObjectGridProps.columns[].summary`; the live save, per-item publish, publish-drafts and three restore doors, and `os validate` / `build` / `lint` / `verify`), the replacement (the fix line the refusal names), the reason (what stored before, what is refused now, and rows stored before the release: a stored page still loads and renders with the page-labelled footer, a live re-save and a restore of a version holding it are refused, a draft blocks its package's publish, a draft save and a delete still work, `OS_ALLOW_UNLINTED_METADATA_WRITES=1` degrades the refusal), and acceptance criteria. Each door and stored-row sentence was read off the tree: `runtime-authoring-gate.ts` (draft skip, escape hatch), `protocol-authoring-gate.ts` (`refuseRestoredBodyTheSaveDoorRefuses`), `runtime-gate.ts` (a written item's own findings are judged against the baseline without it), `meta-item-history-routes.ts` and `dispatcher-plugin.ts` (the restore routes), `useWholeSetSummary.ts` (a refused query reads `UNAVAILABLE`, so the footer is the page's).

**Reach, measured (PM assumption 2).** `ObjectGridRenderer` (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/index.tsx`, registered as `object-grid`) renders `ObjectGrid`, whose `useObjectGridSummaries` reads `normalizeColumns(schema.columns)` and calls `useWholeSetSummary` → `compileWholeSetSummaryQuery` → `wholeSetSummaryNodes` (one node per column summary off `COLUMN_SUMMARY_AGGREGATION`) → `dataSource.queryGroupHeaders` with no `groupBy`, which the data door routes to `engine.aggregate`. It asks only when the footer rows are not the whole set (server-paged, not grouped). A grouped grid's header query is compiled from `aggregations` (`useServerGrouping.summaryColumnsOf`), not from column summaries. A grid whose rows fit one page, or are handed in (`data.provider: 'value'`), sums in the browser, and the declaration is refused all the same (seat ruling A, as the list view's summaries and the value-provider grid).

## Tests

- `validate-sortable-fields.test.ts` › new top-level describe `object-grid column summaries over a refused field type (#32503)`, 14 cases: `sum` over text refused at `error` under the list view's id, with `where` and the summary's path; the object form aggregating `summary.field`; `count_unique` over a JSON-stored field and over a `multiple: true` lookup; `min` over a select; `sum` over a formula; accepted controls (`sum` over a number, `min` / `max` over a date and a datetime, `avg` over a percent, `sum` over a boolean, `count_unique` over a select); `none` / `count` / filled-empty members and a string column list judged nothing; the skips; the `dataSource.object` binding; columns and aggregations of one block side by side under their own ids; a parity sweep (every `ColumnSummary` member × every `FieldType` × `multiple`, grid carrier vs list-view carrier: same severity, message and hint, non-vacuous); the page save door (`runRuntimeAuthoringRules`, type `page`) refuses the text sum and accepts the number sum; the `os explain` text names the carrier. The pins assert rule id, path, severity and the message head, never the remedy wording verbatim (the parity sweep compares the two carriers' hints with each other).
- The `[#22161] one-line verdicts` coverage control now lists `list-view-summary-field-type-refused` among the ids this module fires, so its at-most-200-character bound covers the new findings.

<details><summary>Readings (head b0bc989a)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` under the verify lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`; `Test Files 199 passed (199)`, `Tests 8523 passed (8523)`; `check:test-typecheck: OK`.
- Ablation, once (at `1dc50279`): `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the anchor `if (Array.isArray(props.columns)) {` with `if (false && Array.isArray(props.columns)) {` in `validate-sortable-fields.ts` — anchor 1 → 0, blob `85b88bd84cca` → `a6db922e07f6`. `validate-sortable-fields.test.ts`: `Tests 11 failed | 102 passed (113)` — the 10 new cases that expect a finding plus the one-line coverage control. Restored: blob back to `85b88bd84cca` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The tests import `src/` directly, so no `dist/` leg exists.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **PM assumption 1 — confirmed** on `3452dec2`: `ObjectGridPropsSchema.columns` reuses `ListViewSchema.shape.columns`; `checkColumnSummary` judged list views only; `validateGridAggregations` walked `properties.aggregations` only.
- **First-party exposure on the final head (`b0bc989a`): 0 refused.** `validateSortableFields` over each `examples/*/objectstack.config.ts` stack (app-crm 1 page, app-multi-package 0, app-showcase 29, app-todo 0): 2 `object-grid` components (both in app-showcase, both with `columns`), 0 column summaries, 0 findings. `git grep -c object-grid -- packages/apps` → exit 1, zero matches (and no `pages:` there). Measured with a scratch tsx script, not committed.
- **Not a carrier:** the `record:related_list` block also accepts a `ListColumn` `summary`, but its enlarged grid face hands `object-grid` string column names only (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`), so no summary reaches a footer query from there.
- **Header prose not edited:** `aggregate-pair-verdict.ts`'s module header still names two surfaces; the file is import-only for this card (#32602 is editing it), so the third surface is named in the two callers' docblocks instead.
- **`grid` alias:** the registry also registers `grid` to the same renderer; like `validateGridAggregations` before it, the walk judges `type: 'object-grid'` only.
- Merged `origin/main` (with #32545, `be0c0a21`) before opening; no conflict, the pins do not read the remedy wording.

## Verification

- Local gates: the derived list (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 66 commands, run at `efedbad1`): 62 exit 0. Not measured locally, prerequisite only: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (exit 3, needs an unshallow clone), `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, needs the whole repo built). `check:docs-transcript-drift` and `check:lean-entry-closure` (exit 3, not built at the time) were re-run at `b0bc989a` after building, both exit 0, as were `check:keyed-text-bounds`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:issue-citations`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` and `check-changeset-no-major`.
- Rework round 1 (head `c4236138`): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:migration-registry` wrote `registry.ts` (569 semantic, the new id present) and `vitest run src/migrations` passed 5 files / 198 tests; `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` exit 0 (`registered object-grid-column-summary-refused (new here)`); the #32649 branch's script (`f8e7263f`) with `--base origin/main --head HEAD` exit 0, and with `--head f3338299` (the previous marker) exit 1, refusing `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` on a `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` changeset. The 24 gate families the new spec path adds to the derived list all exit 0 (`check:upgrade-guide`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:docs`, `check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface` among them; `check:doc-formula-expressions` after building lint).
- CI owns the full farm; the two not-measured families are read from this PR's check-runs.
- This is a narrowing: the seat owes a CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review before the queue.
